  "explanation": "Check the counterexample: Liu's marks 1/5, 2/5 give segments 1/5, 1/5, 3/5. Xiang's single cut at 7/10 splits 3/5 into 3/10, 3/10, giving multiset {3/10, 3/10, 1/5, 1/5}; the alternating sum of sorted lengths is 3/10-3/10+1/5-1/5 = 0, so Liu gets exactly 1/2 < 3/5. The proposed equal-spacing division thus fails at n=2, and the write-up contains no other lower-bound argument (it explicitly says the proof is 'To be completed'). The conjectured value (n+1)/(2n+1) is itself wrong (true answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1)), so no local edit repairs it.",
